blocks.zh: 4. Facilities and Engineering Controls | 設施與工程控制
blocks.en: 4. Facilities and Engineering Controls

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SEC vs PEC — 設施層次
blocks.en: Core Concept: SEC vs. PEC - The Facility Hierarchy

blocks.zh: Primary Engineering Control, PEC (主要工程控制)：提供 ISO Class 5 無菌調配環境的設備（如 LAFW、BSC、CAI）。是 CSP 直接調配的工作空間。
blocks.en: Primary Engineering Control (PEC): Equipment that provides an ISO Class 5 environment for sterile compounding (such as an LAFW, BSC or CAI). It is the workspace where the CSP is compounded directly.

blocks.zh: Secondary Engineering Control, SEC (二次工程控制)：放置 PEC 的區域（前室、緩衝室、SCA）。SEC 保護 PEC 免受外部污染。
blocks.en: Secondary Engineering Control (SEC): The area in which the PEC is placed (anteroom, buffer room, SCA). The SEC protects the PEC from external contamination.

blocks.zh: 兩者關係：SEC 是 PEC 的護盾，PEC 是 CSP 的最後防線。
blocks.en: How the two relate: the SEC is the shield for the PEC, and the PEC is the last line of defense for the CSP.

blocks.zh: 比喻：像一個俄羅斯套娃的防護層次
blocks.en: Analogy: Layers of Protection Like Russian Nesting Dolls

blocks.zh: 想像三層保護圈：最外層 = 前室（ISO 8，換衣過渡）→ 中間 = 緩衝室（ISO 7，工作環境）→ 最內層 = PEC（ISO 5，直接調配）。每靠近一層，空氣品質就嚴格一個等級。
blocks.en: Imagine three protective rings: outermost = anteroom (ISO 8, the changing transition) → middle = buffer room (ISO 7, the working environment) → innermost = PEC (ISO 5, direct compounding). Each step inward, the air quality is one grade stricter.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼「從外到內」的方向控制如此重要——永遠不能讓低品質的空氣進入高品質的區域。
blocks.en: This is why directional control "from the outside in" is so important: lower-quality air must never be allowed to flow into a higher-quality area.

blocks.zh: 設施等級快速對照
blocks.en: Quick Reference of Facility Classes

blocks.zh:
[無分類空間] → [前室 ISO 8] → [緩衝室 ISO 7] → [PEC ISO 5]

壓差要求（相鄰區域間）：
  緩衝室 vs 前室：≥ 0.020" 水柱（正壓）
  前室 vs 無分類區：≥ 0.020" 水柱

溫度/濕度：
  ≤ 20°C / ≤ 60% RH（每日監測記錄）
  禁止使用獨立式空調/除濕機
blocks.en:
[Unclassified space] → [Anteroom ISO 8] → [Buffer room ISO 7] → [PEC ISO 5]

Pressure differential requirements (between adjacent areas):
  Buffer room vs. anteroom: ≥ 0.020" water column (positive pressure)
  Anteroom vs. unclassified area: ≥ 0.020" water column

Temperature/humidity:
  ≤ 20°C / ≤ 60% RH (monitored and recorded daily)
  Stand-alone air conditioners/dehumidifiers are prohibited

blocks.zh: 重點提示：SCA 的嚴格限制
blocks.en: Key Point: The Strict Limits of an SCA

blocks.zh: SCA（Segregated Compounding Area，分隔調配區）是一種彈性設計，讓小型診所或緊急情況無需建造完整無菌室。但有鐵律：
blocks.en: An SCA (Segregated Compounding Area) is a flexible design that lets small clinics or emergency situations avoid building a full sterile compounding room. But there are firm rules:

blocks.zh: 只能調配 Category 1 CSP（BUD ≤ 12h 室溫）
blocks.en: Only Category 1 CSPs may be compounded (BUD ≤ 12 h at room temperature)

blocks.zh: PEC 周圍 1 公尺範圍內不得有儲物、洗手、更衣或高產塵活動
blocks.en: No storage, hand washing, garbing or high-particle-generating activities within 1 meter of the PEC

blocks.zh: 不得鄰近廁所、倉庫、食物製備區
blocks.en: Must not be adjacent to restrooms, storerooms or food preparation areas

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某診所將 LAFW 放置在護理站角落（SCA 設計），用於調配 Category 2 IV 輸液。這是否合規？
blocks.en: A clinic places an LAFW in the corner of a nursing station (an SCA design) and uses it to compound Category 2 IV infusions. Is this compliant?

blocks.zh: 前室的「line of demarcation」的目的是什麼？哪邊是「clean side」？
blocks.en: What is the purpose of the "line of demarcation" in an anteroom? Which side is the "clean side"?

blocks.zh: 為什麼禁止在分類區域使用黏性地墊（tacky mats）？
blocks.en: Why is the use of tacky mats prohibited in classified areas?

blocks.zh: 4.2.3 Types of PECs | PEC 類型
blocks.en: 4.2.3 Types of PECs

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PEC 選擇矩陣
blocks.en: Core Concept: The PEC Selection Matrix

blocks.zh: 七種 PEC 看起來複雜，但核心區別只有三個維度：
blocks.en: The seven types of PEC look complicated, but the core differences come down to just three dimensions:

blocks.zh: 開放 vs 封閉：LAFW/BSC 是開放式；CAI/CACI/Pharmaceutical Isolator 是封閉式
blocks.en: Open vs. closed: LAFW/BSC are open; CAI/CACI/Pharmaceutical Isolator are closed

blocks.zh: HD vs 非HD：CACI 和 LAFW（不可用）的 HD 適用性不同
blocks.en: HD vs. non-HD: CACI and LAFW differ in their suitability for HD (an LAFW is not acceptable for HD)

blocks.zh: Category 3 的放置：Pharmaceutical Isolator 只需 ISO Class 8 室，其他 PEC 需要 ISO Class 7 + 8 套組
blocks.en: Placement for Category 3: A Pharmaceutical Isolator needs only an ISO Class 8 room; the other PECs need an ISO Class 7 + 8 suite

blocks.zh: 比喻：CAI vs Pharmaceutical Isolator — 手套箱 vs 隔離艙
blocks.en: Analogy: CAI vs. Pharmaceutical Isolator - Glove Box vs. Isolation Module

blocks.zh: CAI 像是高級手套箱（glove box）：有手套、有 HEPA，但沒有自動去污系統。
blocks.en: A CAI is like a high-end glove box: it has gloves and HEPA filtration but no automated decontamination system.

blocks.zh: Pharmaceutical Isolator 更像太空站的艙室：有完整的傳遞口（RTP）、自動去污系統（如 VHP），是更高層次的隔離。注意：USP 明確規定 CAI ≠ Pharmaceutical Isolator。
blocks.en: A Pharmaceutical Isolator is more like a space station module: it has a complete rapid transfer port (RTP) and an automated decontamination system (such as VHP), a higher level of isolation. Note: USP explicitly states that a CAI is not a Pharmaceutical Isolator.

blocks.zh: ACPH 計算邏輯
blocks.en: ACPH Calculation Logic

blocks.zh:
ISO Class 7 緩衝室：
  總 ACPH ≥ 30
  其中 HVAC 供給 ≥ 15 ACPH
  PEC 貢獻 = 總量 − HVAC量

ISO Class 8 前室：
  總 ACPH ≥ 20
  其中 HVAC 供給 ≥ 15 ACPH

舉例：緩衝室 HVAC 提供 15 ACPH
→ PEC 必須至少再提供 15 ACPH
→ 若 PEC 關閉，等效 ACPH 降為 15 → 違規
→ 因此 PEC 不得在非維護時間關閉！
blocks.en:
ISO Class 7 buffer room:
  Total ACPH ≥ 30
  Of which HVAC supply ≥ 15 ACPH
  PEC contribution = total − HVAC amount

ISO Class 8 anteroom:
  Total ACPH ≥ 20
  Of which HVAC supply ≥ 15 ACPH

Example: the buffer room HVAC provides 15 ACPH
→ the PEC must provide at least another 15 ACPH
→ if the PEC is switched off, the effective ACPH drops to 15 → non-compliant
→ therefore the PEC must not be switched off outside of maintenance periods!

blocks.zh: 重點提示：IVLFZ 的高難度設計
blocks.en: Key Point: The Demanding Design of the IVLFZ

blocks.zh: USP 原文特別注記：動態煙霧測試已顯示 IVLFZ 很難在動態作業條件下維持單向氣流。這是一個隱含的警告，表示 USP 雖不禁止 IVLFZ，但知道其設計具有挑戰性。
blocks.en: The USP text specifically notes that dynamic smoke studies have shown that an IVLFZ has difficulty maintaining unidirectional airflow under dynamic operating conditions. This is an implicit warning: although USP does not prohibit the IVLFZ, it recognizes that the design is challenging.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：若資金允許，選擇傳統 LAFW 或 CAI 通常比 IVLFZ 更容易通過煙霧測試認證。
blocks.en: Practical advice: if funding allows, a conventional LAFW or CAI is usually easier than an IVLFZ to get through smoke study certification.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：Pharmaceutical Isolator 的 Category 2/3 優勢
blocks.en: Practical Application: The Category 2/3 Advantage of a Pharmaceutical Isolator

blocks.zh: 對需要調配 Category 2/3 CSP 的設施，Pharmaceutical Isolator 有一個重要優勢：只需要 ISO Class 8 室（不需要前室）。這可以節省相當可觀的設施建設成本。
blocks.en: For facilities that need to compound Category 2/3 CSPs, a Pharmaceutical Isolator has one important advantage: it needs only an ISO Class 8 room (no anteroom is required). This can save considerable facility construction cost.

blocks.zh: 代價是 Pharmaceutical Isolator 本身購置和維護成本較高，需要做總擁有成本（TCO）分析。
blocks.en: The trade-off is that the Pharmaceutical Isolator itself costs more to purchase and maintain, so a total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis should be done.

blocks.zh: 某設施使用 CAI 調配 Category 2 CSP，緩衝室 HVAC 提供 18 ACPH，CAI 貢獻 14 ACPH，總計 32 ACPH。是否符合要求？
blocks.en: A facility uses a CAI to compound Category 2 CSPs. The buffer room HVAC provides 18 ACPH and the CAI contributes 14 ACPH, for a total of 32 ACPH. Does this meet the requirement?

blocks.zh: CACI 和 CAI 的主要差異是什麼？各適用於何種 CSP？
blocks.en: What are the main differences between a CACI and a CAI? Which CSPs is each suitable for?

blocks.zh: 若設施要新增 Pharmaceutical Isolator 調配 Category 3 CSP，是否需要建造前室？
blocks.en: If a facility wants to add a Pharmaceutical Isolator to compound Category 3 CSPs, does it need to build an anteroom?

blocks.zh: 5. Certification and Recertification | 認證與再認證
blocks.en: 5. Certification and Recertification

blocks.zh: 核心概念：認證的四個測試項目
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Four Tests in Certification

blocks.zh: 每次認證/再認證必須包含「四合一」測試：
blocks.en: Every certification/recertification must include a "four-in-one" set of tests:

blocks.zh: 氣流測試 (Airflow Testing)：測量風速、ACPH、壓差
blocks.en: Airflow Testing: measures air velocity, ACPH and pressure differentials

blocks.zh: HEPA 濾芯完整性測試：確認無洩漏點
blocks.en: HEPA filter integrity testing: confirms there are no leaks

blocks.zh: 總微粒計數 (Total Particle Count)：動態條件下測 ≥0.5µm 微粒數量
blocks.en: Total Particle Count: measures the number of particles ≥0.5µm under dynamic conditions

blocks.zh: 動態煙霧測試 (Dynamic Smoke Pattern Test)：視覺確認單向氣流覆蓋
blocks.en: Dynamic Smoke Pattern Test: visually confirms coverage by unidirectional airflow

blocks.zh: 每6個月一次，並在任何可能影響氣流的變更後立即重新認證。
blocks.en: Performed every 6 months, and immediately re-performed after any change that could affect airflow.

blocks.zh: 比喻：像汽車定期年檢
blocks.en: Analogy: Like a Periodic Vehicle Inspection

blocks.zh: 認證就像汽車年檢——你的車每年必須通過煞車、排放、安全燈等多項測試。即使看起來沒問題，法規仍要求定期驗證。
blocks.en: Certification is like a vehicle inspection: every year your car must pass tests of the brakes, emissions, safety lights and more. Even if it looks fine, the regulations still require periodic verification.

blocks.zh: 同理，即使調配室「感覺正常」，每6個月的認證仍是強制的，因為 HEPA 可能有微小洩漏、壓差感測器可能漂移，只有測試才能確認。
blocks.en: In the same way, even if the compounding room "feels normal", certification every 6 months is mandatory, because the HEPA filter may have a tiny leak and the pressure sensor may drift; only testing can confirm.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：動態 vs 靜態煙霧測試
blocks.en: Key Point: Dynamic vs. Static Smoke Tests

blocks.zh: USP 要求的是動態 (Dynamic) 煙霧測試——在人員存在且模擬操作的條件下進行。靜態測試（無人、無操作）不能充分代表實際調配時的氣流狀況。
blocks.en: USP requires a dynamic smoke test, performed with personnel present and simulated operations under way. A static test (no people, no operations) does not adequately represent the airflow during actual compounding.

blocks.zh: 煙霧測試的目的：確認單向氣流能「掃過」(sweep) 直接調配區 (DCA)，而不是在某處形成渦流（eddies）或停滯區（dead zones）。
blocks.en: The purpose of the smoke test: to confirm that unidirectional airflow can "sweep" the direct compounding area (DCA), rather than forming eddies or dead zones somewhere.

blocks.zh: 認證頻率規則
blocks.en: Certification Frequency Rules

blocks.zh:
必須認證的時機：
  ✓ 初始使用前
  ✓ 至少每 6 個月一次
  ✓ 設施改建或重新設計後
  ✓ 任何 PEC 更換或移位後
  ✓ 任何可能影響氣流的房間改變後

認證報告必須包含：
  HVAC 的 ACPH + PEC 貢獻的 ACPH + 總 ACPH
  測試期間 PEC/SEC 中的人員數量
blocks.en:
When certification is required:
  ✓ Before initial use
  ✓ At least once every 6 months
  ✓ After facility renovation or redesign
  ✓ After any PEC replacement or relocation
  ✓ After any room change that could affect airflow

The certification report must include:
  HVAC ACPH + PEC-contributed ACPH + total ACPH
  Number of personnel in the PEC/SEC during testing

blocks.zh: 實務應用：搬移設備即觸發重新認證
blocks.en: Practical Application: Moving Equipment Triggers Recertification

blocks.zh: 這是設施管理中常被忽略的規定：任何 PEC 的位置改變（即使只是稍微移動以便清潔），理論上都應重新進行動態煙霧測試，因為設備位置影響氣流模式。實務上建議在 SOP 中設定明確的「允許位移範圍」，超出即觸發重新認證。
blocks.en: This is a requirement often overlooked in facility management: any change in the location of a PEC (even a slight move to allow cleaning) should in theory trigger a repeat dynamic smoke test, because equipment position affects the airflow pattern. In practice, it is advisable to set a clear "permitted displacement range" in the SOP, with anything beyond it triggering recertification.

blocks.zh: 認證中的 HEPA 完整性測試需要在幾個時間點進行？各是什麼時機？
blocks.en: At how many points in time does the HEPA integrity test during certification need to be performed? What is the timing of each?

blocks.zh: 動態微粒計數測試超出 ISO Class 7 限制（>352,000 /m³），必須採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: A dynamic particle count test exceeds the ISO Class 7 limit (>352,000 /m³). What steps must be taken?

blocks.zh: 設施在 2 月完成認證，6 月進行例行 HEPA 更換。更換後需要立即重新認證嗎？
blocks.en: A facility completed certification in February and performs a routine HEPA filter replacement in June. Does it need to be recertified immediately after the replacement?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: SEC 層次：前室（ISO 8）→ 緩衝室（ISO 7）→ PEC（ISO 5）；每層間壓差 ≥ 0.020" 水柱
blocks.en: SEC hierarchy: anteroom (ISO 8) → buffer room (ISO 7) → PEC (ISO 5); pressure differential between each level ≥ 0.020" water column

blocks.zh: PEC 選擇：LAFW/BSC/CAI 用於 Cat 2/3 需 ISO 7+8 套組；Pharmaceutical Isolator 只需 ISO 8 室
blocks.en: PEC selection: an LAFW/BSC/CAI used for Cat 2/3 needs an ISO 7+8 suite; a Pharmaceutical Isolator needs only an ISO 8 room

blocks.zh: ACPH：ISO Class 7 ≥30 ACPH（含 HVAC ≥15）；ISO Class 8 ≥20 ACPH（含 HVAC ≥15）
blocks.en: ACPH: ISO Class 7 ≥30 ACPH (including HVAC ≥15); ISO Class 8 ≥20 ACPH (including HVAC ≥15)

blocks.zh: 認證：初始 + 每6個月，包含氣流測試、HEPA 完整性、總微粒計數、動態煙霧測試四項
blocks.en: Certification: initial + every 6 months, covering four tests: airflow testing, HEPA integrity, total particle count and dynamic smoke pattern test

blocks.zh: SCA：僅適用 Category 1 CSP；PEC 周圍 1 公尺須專用於無菌調配
blocks.en: SCA: suitable for Category 1 CSPs only; the 1 meter around the PEC must be dedicated to sterile compounding
